notes: SC TO-C pre-commencement communication (Aug 13, 2021): the Adviser recommended the Board approve a tender for up to $50 million in aggregate value of HFRO common shares at 95% of NAV struck at close of business on the business day before expiry. Size is stated only in dollars ($50 million), so size_shares and size_pct_outstanding are null. No commencement or expiration date: the tender is expected to commence as soon as practicable after shareholder approval of the Proposals, and not later than 60 days after that date. Proration not stated. Conditions: contingent on shareholder approval of the conversion Proposals at the Aug 20, 2021 Special Meeting and on Board approval of the tender (Board approval mapped to board_discretion). trigger_origin 'other': the tender is tied to a holding-company conversion proposal and was added in response to shareholder feedback during the solicitation (not a merger, not an activist settlement). Second event: the proposal to convert the closed-end fund to a diversified holding company (deregistration under the 1940 Act), recorded as kind 'liquidation' with action 'other' since no enum value fits; the filing says the conversion process could take approximately 24 months.
